body.value: 藩制一覽表第八　（田安）
藩制一覧表 第八（田安）／はんせいいちらんひょう だいはち（たやす）

Han-sei Ichiran-hyō, Fascicle 8 (Tayasu) — the outer-margin running header giving the survey title, the fascicle number, and the header-designated domain. Provenance only, not data. It names 田安, the domain whose maru-marker opens on this folio; it does not name the owner of the three columns that print to the right of that marker, which belong to the previous domain, Takase. Read glyph by glyph at 5x: 藩 制 一 覽 表 第 八, then the parenthetical （田安）. Ink measured x2150-2206, y1234-1793 in the column x2150-2210; box pads 10px on three sides and 14px on the right.
藩制一覽表第八（田安）
兵隊　三小隊
兵隊 三小隊／へいたい さんしょうたい

Troops: three platoons. Takase's line, not Tayasu's — it prints to the RIGHT of the ○田安藩 marker (兵隊 at x2016-2087 vs marker at x1611-1697), so by the boundary rule it closes the preceding entry, the standard vol.2 fascicle-8 overflow in which a domain's military prints after its officials and spills past the next domain's marker. Confirmed by the preceding folio lower_p188_left (三百五十三 = 353), which carries the ○高瀨藩 marker and Takase's 執政 / 參政 / 公議人 columns with no military line at all. The numeral was checked at 4x: 三 is three clean horizontals (row runs 1655-1683 merged pair, 1698-1707), not 五. Ink x2016-2087, y1231-1879; box pads 9-11px.
高瀨兵隊
砲兵　貳車
砲兵 二車／ほうへい にりょう

Artillery: two gun-carriages. Takase's line, printing to the RIGHT of the ○田安藩 marker and therefore belonging to the preceding entry. Read at 4x: 貳 is the formal form of 2, and the counter is 車 (carriage, i.e. a mounted piece). Ink x1881-1951, y1231-1799; box pads 10px on all four sides.
高瀨砲兵
合百九十九人
合 百九十九人／あわせて ひゃくきゅうじゅうくにん

Total: 199 men. The page's own sum of the two preceding Takase lines (three platoons of infantry plus two artillery carriages); three platoons at roughly sixty each plus two gun crews reconciles with 199. Still Takase's, printing to the RIGHT of the ○田安藩 marker. Checked at 4x: six glyphs, 合 百 九 十 九 人; the tens glyph is a plain cross 十 with no slanted top stroke, so 199 and not 10,099, and the terminal glyph's two strokes touch at the apex, so 人 not 八. A stray solid ink blob at x1804-1830, y1072-1104 sits about 200px above the 合 glyph; it has no glyph structure (an unbroken 27x33px rectangle at 8x) and is deliberately excluded from this box. Ink x1754-1821, y1318-1797; box pads 9-11px.
高瀨兵員合計
○田安藩
○田安藩／たやすはん

Maru-marker opening the Tayasu-domain entry, and the only maru-marker on the folio. Columns to its LEFT are Tayasu's (官員 不詳, 兵士 五百人, 兵卒 百五十人, 別段組立兵士 二百人 内百人狙擊隊); the three columns to its RIGHT are the military tail of the previous domain, Takase, whose marker and officials print on the preceding folio lower_p188_left. Read at 4x: a clean open circle, then 田, 安, 藩, on the wide spacing HI uses for domain names (98px gaps between name glyphs against 20-30px between glyphs in the data columns). Ink x1611-1697, y1324-1864; box pads 9-10px.
○田安藩
官員　不詳
官員 不詳／かんいん ふしょう

Officials: not detailed. Tayasu returned no breakdown of its office-holders, so the whole officials section that fascicle 8 normally itemizes (大參事, 權大參事, 少參事 and so on, with names) is replaced by this single absence note. The column sits immediately left of the ○田安藩 marker and is therefore Tayasu's. No figure is recorded, so no parsed value is given. Ink x1483-1551, y1235-1797; box pads 9-10px. A 9x9px speck at x1576-1584, y1360-1368 lies in the gutter between this column and the marker and is excluded from both boxes.
田安官員
兵士　五百人
兵士 五百人／へいし ごひゃくにん

Soldiers of samurai rank: 500 men. Tayasu's, printing left of the ○田安藩 marker. Verified at 4x and the terminal glyph again at 8x: 五 shows the closed Z-turn that distinguishes it from 三, and the last glyph's two strokes join into a single stem at the apex, so 人 and not 八. Five glyph runs in all (1237-1298, 1322-1380, 1660-1715, 1743-1805, 1825-1884), so the value is three glyphs, 五百人. Ink x1356-1422, y1237-1884; box pads 9-11px.
田安兵士
兵卒　百五十人
兵卒 百五十人／へいそつ ひゃくごじゅうにん

Rank-and-file soldiers: 150 men. Tayasu's. The column has exactly six glyph runs (1235-1297, 1319-1383, 1655-1716, 1742-1795, 1826-1885, 1908-1968), so the value is four glyphs, 百五十人. Each was re-cropped alone: 百 and 五 at 7x, the tens glyph at 9x where it shows a plain cross 十 with no slanted top stroke (so 150, not 1,500), and the terminal glyph at 9x where its two strokes join into a single stem at the apex, so 人 and not 八. The figure is 150, not the 158 that a low-resolution reading of the same column suggests. Ink x1225-1292, y1235-1968; box pads 9-11px.
田安兵卒
別段組立兵士　二百人　内百人狙擊隊
別段組立兵士 二百人 内百人狙撃隊／べつだんくみたてへいし にひゃくにん うちひゃくにんそげきたい

Separately organized soldiers: 200 men, of whom 100 form a sharpshooter unit. Tayasu's, the leftmost column on the folio. 別段組立 prints as a 2x2 warichu in small type (49px tall against 60-62px for the full-size glyphs) heading full-size 兵士: reading the right sub-column first gives 別 over 段, then the left gives 組 over 立. The 内 introducing the sub-count is likewise small type, and is not boxed on its own. The numeral 二 is two short horizontals (row runs 1660-1670, 1695-1706), and the penultimate glyph of 狙擊隊 is the kyūjitai 擊 (modern 撃), over-inked but showing the blocky left element over a bottom horizontal with the 手 hook at 8x. With 兵士 500 and 兵卒 150 this brings Tayasu's forces to 850 men, of whom 100 are sharpshooters. The page prints no Tayasu total, and none follows elsewhere: this column ends the Tayasu entry and with it fascicle 8, because the facing verso lower_p189_left (folio 三百五十五 = 355) opens fascicle 9 under a large-type title 藩制一覽表第九 with the ○園部藩 marker. Ink x1072-1167, y1235-2478; box pads 9-10px.
田安別段組立兵士
三百五十四
三百五十四／さんびゃくごじゅうよん

Printed book-page (folio) number 354, in the bottom of the outer margin, in the same column as the running header. Verified at 6x: five glyphs, 三 百 五 十 四; the fourth is a plain cross 十 with no slanted top stroke, so the value is 354 and not 3054. It follows the 三百五十三 (353) on lower_p188_left and precedes the 三百五十五 (355) on lower_p189_left, confirming leaf order. Ink x2160-2210, y3076-3321; box pads 10px on all four sides.
三百五十四
